summary: Every CAD feature kind is declared once, in src/domain/cad/features/kinds/, and registered in cadFeatureRegistry.ts. A definition gives the kind's family, stored schema and fields, its outputs, body behaviour and what it leaves when inactive, its evaluator and version, every diagnostic code its checks and evaluation raise apart from those all kinds share, and its checks. What a kind shows people and agents, its form and agent exposure, is its entry in CAD_FEATURE_PRESENTATION, which the kernel worker never loads. Each id-holding field is a slot that names its role, the trait it accepts (plane, sketch, curve or body), whether it is required, optional or many and whether its order matters; each dimension is a scalar with its quantity, range and components, and a field holding nested numbers declares by path what each one measures; choices and conditional fields, such as a target that exists only for join and cut, are declared with them. Pattern counts are integer scalars of 2 to 100, read by the document check and the kernel's pattern limit. The document parser checks references, dimensions, conditions, kind checks and solid instance budgets through the definitions instead of a switch over kinds. cadFeatureInputs, cadFeatureDependencies and cadConsumedBodyIds read the slots through one traversal; mapCadFeatureScalars reads the scalars. The CAD agent tools list kinds, descriptions and schemas from the definitions and presentation entries. The feature editor draws revolve, loft, sweep, fillet, chamfer, shell, boolean, move and rotate, both patterns and mirror from each kind's form controls, and keeps its own editors for datum planes, imports, sketches, curves, Extrude and Pocket; feature labels come from the form titles. Whether a feature takes part in a rebuild is read only through cadFeatureActive(feature, scope), which replaces all 119 reads of the stored suppressed flag; npm run lint now runs scripts/check-feature-activity.ts, which refuses any other read that names the flag, including computed keys, destructuring assignment and reflective methods named by a literal key. Revolve and circular-pattern axes and mirror planes stay stored as choices of world axes and planes until K4 turns them into slots. Tests derive each kind's diagnostic list from the source and check that every number a stored feature holds has one declared quantity. The kernel parity corpus gains an imported STL solid, so it covers all 17 kinds. docs/maintainers/cad-features.md explains how to add a kind and carries a table generated from the definitions, which a test keeps current.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files, agent tools or controller output. The CAD document and edit schemas, agent tool schemas and descriptions, parsed documents, diagnostics and kernel geometry are byte-identical to main at d1b4c4c3 (0.0.793), this change's base, and to main at 88f9d0fd (0.0.794) after it was merged in, before and after review round 1. Review round 2 changes only tests, the feature activity check and one diagnostic list, which only tests read; review round 3 changes only tests, the feature activity check and maintainer notes.

checklist.schema: No CAD document, sketch, UPID, post, machine package, saved revision, worker message, storage or journal change. The published CAD document schema, edit schema and every feature variant are byte-identical, in the same union and property order. Post engine API remains 1, saved-job engine remains 3 and CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation, input-version or WebMCP behaviour change. Agent tools, their arguments, guards and replies are unchanged; initial CAD discovery stays at 51,178 of its 51,200 UTF-8 bytes, and cad_describe_features and cad_describe_edits return byte-identical replies. Every diagnostic code and message is unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change and no new application controls. The feature editor renders the same controls, labels, values and options as before.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change. Kernel geometry, previews and STEP and STL exports are unchanged.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Documents load, validate, rebuild and save to the same bytes.
checklist.verification: Parity, against a second checkout of main at d1b4c4c3 (0.0.793): agent tool metadata (51,178 bytes), the cad_describe_features and cad_describe_edits replies, the document schema, the edit schema and every feature variant are byte-identical. Over the 16 kernel parity documents of that time, which include the 6 benchmark steps, taken as 22 inputs with the steps a second time from the benchmark cases, parsed documents, validation results, parameter inspection, visible bodies and each feature's inputs, dependencies, consumed bodies and scalar paths are identical, and so are the codes and messages of 2,861 diagnostics from mutated variants of them: suppression toggles, deletions, features moved first or last, every id field, plane and section list retargeted, bad dimensions, pattern counts 1, 101, 2.5 and 50, zero spacing, changed operations, a tool pointed at its own target and duplicate ids. The feature editor gives identical DOM and control values in 198 renders across 15 kinds, including operation changes that show or hide a target, Loft transitions, circular-pattern axes and fillet and chamfer selections, tangent propagation and scope. The only internal difference is the solid instance count recorded for a sketch, now 0 instead of 1, which nothing reads. Mutations, each alone against the 4,161 tests of src/domain/cad and src/features/cad: Boolean's toolId declared as a plain field fails 19 tests in 11 files; Sweep's curveId slot accepting a sketch fails 48 tests in 13 files; the kernel skipping a feature by reading feature.suppressed fails npm run lint, naming the line, and the repository scan test; Sweep's curveId slot reading no ids fails 3 tests in 2 files. Timing, alternating fresh processes of main and this branch started only while no other test, build or benchmark ran, best minimums: kernel builds of plate-hole-pattern 62.51 to 62.33 ms and 60.46 to 60.32 ms after an edit, gear-and-plate 1125.64 to 1101.96 ms and 1083.67 to 1093.49 ms, box-fillet-all-edges 85.76 to 84.52 ms and 79.07 to 77.55 ms (3 clean pairs of 7 samples); boundary parse of 32 sketches 49.65 to 49.64 ms, 32 extruded sketches 101.80 to 101.51 ms, 8 extruded sketches 24.07 to 24.33 ms, dependent sketches 5.37 to 5.32 ms and all 22 inputs, the 16 parity documents and then the 6 benchmark steps again, 26.72 to 26.20 ms (7 clean pairs of 60 samples); viewport references on each drag preview, prepared 200.9 to 202.8, 194.0 to 194.6, 141.8 to 141.6 and 128.2 to 127.3 µs and selected 40.9 to 41.3, 33.5 to 33.7, 11.0 to 11.2 and 5.2 to 5.2 µs for 32 sketches, 32 extruded sketches, 8 extruded sketches and dependent sketches (8 clean pairs of 300 samples). An earlier run measured dependent selection 2 to 4% slower; cadFeatureInputs copied each slot's ids once more than main did and now returns them read-only, as main did. The 32-sketch selection's paired median varied from 1.007 to 1.024 across two runs of the same code, and its parts take the same time on both sides in-process. The workbench's selected reference plane is keyed on the document's id and parameters, so it keeps its identity across other edits as before. After merging main at 88f9d0fd (0.0.794): the agent tool, schema, document and diagnostic captures and the editor DOM were taken again against a checkout of 88f9d0fd and are identical; initial CAD discovery stays at 51,178 bytes; 0.0.794's symmetric-curve relation names only entities of its own sketch, so a sketch's inputs remain its external references, and it adds no read of the stored suppressed flag. After review round 1: the activity check also refuses computed keys written as literals and destructuring assignment at any depth, beside defaults and rest siblings, with a scan test case for each form; it leaves key enumeration, spreads, serialization, run-time keys and comparisons with the string alone, as its comment records. Each kind lists every code its checks and kernel evaluation can raise, less three shared groups (document parse, expressions, rebuild); cadFeatureDiagnostics.test.ts follows calls from each definition and kernel case with the TypeScript compiler API and requires each list to equal the codes reached, and a CadError added to Shell's kernel case fails it. Fields holding nested numbers declare their quantities by path; cadFeatureQuantities.test.ts requires every number or scalar each kind's schema accepts to match exactly one declared pattern, each pattern to match one, and every number and expression stored in the 17 kernel parity documents, the 6 benchmark steps among them, to resolve; a removed and an added declaration each fail it. Forms and agent exposure moved into CAD_FEATURE_PRESENTATION, a record keyed by every kind, and a test checks that the kernel worker reaches the registry but not that record. An imported STL solid, cut and moved, joins the kernel parity corpus, so it covers all 17 kinds; main at 88f9d0fd reproduces every kernel fingerprint, including the new part's, and the agent tool, schema, document, diagnostic (2,915 variants) and editor (203 renders across 17 kinds) captures are byte-identical to main's. Bundle, production builds of main at 88f9d0fd and this change: main-thread JavaScript goes from 4,377.62 to 4,390.53 kB (1,271.90 to 1,276.47 kB gzip), the main chunk from 744.98 to 748.55 kB and the kernel worker from 758.55 to 770.43 kB (224.32 to 228.08 kB gzip), against 775.68 kB before the presentation moved out; built with empty diagnostic lists and no quantity declarations the worker is 764.51 kB, so the lists add 4.7 kB and the quantities 1.2 kB; all JavaScript grows 0.42%, and the build warnings are identical. After review round 2: the diagnostics walk reads a code through constants, properties of object literals, elements of list literals, for…of variables, the first parameter of an iteration callback and a parameter at each walked call of its function. It reads every code property the same way, templates included, and reports any code it cannot trace, so a constant code and a template code held by a constant object, which it used to accept without a record, are now collected or reported. It takes a caught CadError's code or the code an inspection returns from where it was written only at 11 sites, each read by hand and listed in the test, so a new site fails it. cadDiagnosticReach.test.ts runs the walk over source text: both forms, the reported forms, parameters read only at walked calls, and the taken sites. The issue codes of sketch graphs (invalid-coordinate, degenerate-entity, arc-radius-mismatch, relation-residual) and sketch arrangements (overlap, ambiguous-tangency, precision, non-simple-boundary) are listed as no refusal of a feature, because a check that finds an issue refuses with its own code and the issue's message; relation-residual leaves the Sketch list. The activity check reads a reflective method named after a dot or by a literal key, for the method and for a call or apply around it, with nine scan cases, among them Reflect['get'](feature, 'suppressed'), Reflect.get['apply'] and Object['prototype']['hasOwnProperty'][`apply`]. cadKernelParityModels holds 17 documents, the 6 benchmark steps among them, so the earlier count of 23 took the steps twice; the counts above are corrected, and the quantities test already covered the benchmark steps. Bundle of the final build: main-thread JavaScript 4,390.51 kB (1,276.48 kB gzip), the main chunk 748.55 kB (221.64 kB gzip), the kernel worker 770.41 kB (228.07 kB gzip) and all JavaScript 5,912.00 kB, 0.42% over main. No capture reads the diagnostic lists and the agent tools never list them, so the captures are unchanged. After review round 3: the diagnostics walk reads a call through what the function it calls returns, each return of a source function or of one held by a constant or a property it reads. It also reads names destructured from a constant, a for…of list or a parameter, a table entry read by a key it cannot tell through every property, both sides of ??, || and &&, and a spread or computed key before a property. A literal computed key counts as a plain property name. The inspection results it used to take on trust are traced: an inspection return with a ['code'] key added to inspectCadLoftSketch now fails the Loft and Sweep tests, and a return of inspections.get(sketch.id) is reported for both. Only 3 caught errors' codes are still taken on trust, each listed in the test. Every kind's list and every shared group are unchanged. The feature activity check reads a constant key from the declaration the TypeScript checker binds its name to, over the file alone, so an inner declaration of the same name shadows an outer one; a scan test checks both directions, and round 2's check missed both reads of its first case. The check takes 2.3 s over 619 files instead of 2.0 s. The build output and the parity captures are unchanged. Checks on the final tree: npm test -- --run, 627 files and 7,307 tests, passes; npm run build (tsc -b and vite build), npm run lint with zero findings (oxlint, the precision literal check and the feature activity check over 619 source files), npm run ui:check and check-release, alone and against origin/main at 0.0.794, pass; initial CAD discovery stays at 51,178 bytes. Chromium specs on the round 1 build, each run alone with --workers=2 (rounds 2 and 3 change no code they run): cad-workflow 32, cad-sketch-constraints 28, cad-sketch-selectable-axes 8, cad-plane-selection-section 6, cad-topology-repick 3, cad-kernel 2, cad-region-workflow 1, cad-intersecting-areas 1, agent-file-import 1 and agent-session-recovery 1 pass. No controller or machine verification is claimed; no output path changed.

changes: Declares each CAD feature kind once, with its inputs, outputs and diagnostics, and keeps its form and agent description beside it, with no visible change.
